findings.text: The construction recipe removes the source INSERTs, but ADR 0031 D6 requires the schema’s source text before the generated INSERTs, so the specifications prescribe different replay contents. Fix: reconcile the source-row policy with D6 and record any changed decision with its date.

Compiling a screen for each pool value contradicts both the one-screen-per-claim requirement above and ADR 0031 D2’s single compilation over the chosen inputs. Fix: compile one screen per claim with the database, environment and named values as inputs.
